events.title: "Imagine" Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon released his timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Today we're celebrating the 75th birthday of legendary musician and former Police frontman, Sting.

angles.name: Sting's Versatility
angles.copy: From The Police to a stellar solo career, Sting turns 75 today! His incredible versatility in music continues to inspire. What's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you held an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed the game for portable music. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Today celebrates 007's big screen debut in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, universally known as "The White Album," was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its sprawling, experimental sound still captivates. What's your hidden gem track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost a true legend. Remembering Freddie Mercury, whose incredible voice and showmanship continue to define rock music.

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album "Rubber Soul" was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal moment in music history. Which track from this iconic album is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: On this solemn day, we remember John Lennon, who left us 46 years ago. His vision of peace and extraordinary music continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: What a starman! Today, David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday. His constant reinvention and musical genius left an indelible mark. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Remembering "The King" Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Long live The King! On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we honour Elvis Presley, whose music and charisma changed the world forever.

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the guitar god, Jimmy Page! His riffs with Led Zeppelin are legendary. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the 82nd birthday of rock legend and distinctive vocalist, Sir Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Rod's Raspy Voice
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! His iconic raspy voice has given us decades of hits. What's your go-to Rod Stewart anthem?

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of British ska legends Madness.

angles.name: Suggs' Nutty Sound
angles.copy: It must be love! Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic voice of Madness. What's your favourite nutty sound from him?
